supplier.statement: For the quotient A_f in Theorem1, the pullback of invariant differentials is the span of the conjugate eigenforms; for rational coefficient field it is the line C f(z)dz.

publication.title: On the factors of the jacobian variety of a modular function field
publication.venue: Journal of the Mathematical Society of Japan25(1973),523–544
publication.corrections: Only the differential-subspace assertion is imported; extra involution action is a separate current hypothesis.

available_assertion.statement: For the quotient A_f in Theorem1, the pullback of invariant differentials is the span of the conjugate eigenforms; for rational coefficient field it is the line C f(z)dz.
available_assertion.objects: Normalized common eigenform f, its coefficient field K, Jacobian J and quotient A_f.
available_assertion.hypotheses: Theorem1 common Hecke eigenform hypotheses and its constructed quotient; K=Q for the one-dimensional specialization.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every quotient and eigenform satisfying the cited theorem.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Weight two; the quotient dimension equals [K:Q].
available_assertion.uniformity: The same quotient and differential subspace throughout.
available_assertion.constants: No period or Manin constant is specified.
available_assertion.normalizations: The theorem identifies differential pullback via the modular curve/Jacobian identification.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No action of an extra involution is asserted here.
available_assertion.limit_order: Construct the eigenquotient before comparing the action of W on its differential line.

needed_assertion.statement: For the actual fixed eigenquotient and stipulated Atkin-Lehner eigen-involution, pi(Wx)=[w]pi(x)+pi(W infinity); the constant lies in the cuspidal image killed by the separate fixed C_pi.
needed_assertion.objects: The fixed pi=alpha q_f based at infinity and the involution W of main3827.
needed_assertion.hypotheses: Existing rational eigenquotient and characteristic-zero Q-isogeny alpha; W*(f dz)=w f dz as stipulated; W permutes cusps; the separate cuspidal torsion input supplies C_pi.
needed_assertion.quantifiers: Every x on the actual modular curve and every W satisfying the stated hypothesis.
needed_assertion.parameter_range: w=1 or-1; the actual fixed level N.
needed_assertion.uniformity: One fixed cuspidal exponent works for these cusp translations.
needed_assertion.constants: c in pi*omega=c f dz is nonzero and cancels; no value is needed.
needed_assertion.normalizations: pi(infinity)=0, action on differential f(z)dz, no root-number sign substitution.
needed_assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not establish a root-number formula or integral extension of pi.
needed_assertion.limit_order: Fix quotient and differential line, apply stipulated W action, evaluate constant at infinity, then use the separate C_pi.
